physics.where_iam_law: the unmarked side of IAM-A: a stray mark is a WRITE error on a site held bare; the law prices the hold of the bare state; the meter's own false marks (incomplete bisulfite conversion) must be subtracted before the write error can be compared with any physical prediction (register A17, then A15)
physics.counterparts: kept in the private cross-domain register (not in public files)

data.set: the 20 libraries already read for PHY-085 (6, GSE227977), PHY-086 P4 (4, GSE161463), P5 (4, GSE66834) and PHY-090 (6, GSE72630): all spent
data.protocol_read: standard sheared WGBS libraries (each checked at design for P4, P5, P7; PHY-085 GSE227977 checked 11-13)
data.spent_first: yes: every library is spent; nothing reserved is touched

form.form: raw reads from SRA, 2 million pairs in the existing block plan (erase_test.yml with maxpairs=2000000), aligned, then the chain's BAM route (run_sample.py --bam) which records conversion failure from non-CpG calls

form.why_not: pat files keep CpG calls only; conversion failure needs non-CpG calls
a conversion rate is measured on billions of non-CpG calls; 2 million pairs give over 100 million, enough

data.alternatives: the deposited per-site calls do not carry non-CpG calls for these sets
data.needs: paired reads, mm10, the chain's BAM route

preflight.checked: stage_q2_selfref.count_bam_region records nc_m / nc_t (conv_fail) and A/T substitutions (sub_err) on the BAM route; erase_gh.sh writes the BAM before bam2pat
preflight.result: the chain already measures conversion failure on a BAM; erase_gh.sh needs one optional step to run the chain on its own BAM

kiss.smallest: the 14 spent libraries, 2 million pairs each
kiss.samples_why: every library whose stray marks are already counted, so each gets its own meter correction

machines.github_free_at_design: about 10 of 20 free at 8:00 PM Pacific

save.resume: each library is its own run; a failed run is re-sent alone

cosmologist.method: calibrate each detector on its own known-zero channel: non-CpG sites are (almost) never methylated in these cells, so their methylated calls measure the meter's false-mark rate in that same library (CMB: each detector's dark/null channel)
cosmologist.null_test: conversion failure must agree between the two runs of one library where a library has two runs, and stay below 1 %; else the library is not assessed

value.question: the meter's false-mark rate in each spent library, to subtract from its stray-mark rate (A17), giving the unmarked side's true write error for the derivation (A15)
value.adequate: stray marks about 1-2 % of bare sites; typical conversion failure 0.2-0.5 %: the correction is 10-50 % of the signal, so it matters and is measurable

options.name: 14 spent libraries at 2 million pairs on GitHub

value.why_this: free, under an hour per library, and a rate needs little depth

explore.done: the stray-mark rates of all 14 libraries are already counted (counts in DEV_ERASE_01); the chain's BAM counter already computes conv_fail

prediction.form: none sealed: exploration (a measured input for A15)
prediction.reading: conv_fail and sub_err from the chain's BAM route; gain_err from the same run for a like-for-like check against the full-depth count

bars.rule: no seal: exploration; conv_fail reported per library with its counting uncertainty
